trap.label: depth
trap.wrong: The portrait has a shallow deep of field.
trap.right: The portrait has a shallow depth of field.
trap.why: Em português “profundidade” é um substantivo. O aluno usa deep (adjetivo) em vez de depth.

fix.wrong: Use a fast shutter for freeze the motion.
fix.right: Use a fast shutter to freeze the motion.

fix.wrong: She shot at low ISO for have less noise.
fix.right: She shot at low ISO to have less noise.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com wide aperture: “A big opening gives a blurred background.”
rewrite.answer: A wide aperture gives a blurred background.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com to: “Use a fast shutter for freezing motion.” (to…)
rewrite.answer: Use a fast shutter to freeze motion.

rewrite.prompt: Corrija deep por depth: “The deep of field is shallow.”
rewrite.answer: The depth of field is shallow.
